links.outcome: CliniKiosk RAG kiosk accuracy versus GPT-4o, Claude 3 Opus, Mixtral, Gemma on same cases
links.effect: Triage 88.6% for CliniKiosk; differential diagnosis >92% for all models (p=0.865); final diagnosis lower for CliniKiosk (76.0%); treatment accuracy 84.5%, GPT-4o and Claude Opus better (p<0.0001).
links.quote: Final-diagnosis accuracy was lower for CliniKiosk (76.0%) compared with other LLMs.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented generation pipeline connected to PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, and clinical guideline sources
Empathy and explainability evaluation of LLM responses

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a new agentic RAG-based digital health kiosk (CliniKiosk) against general-purpose LLMs on 500 simulated patient vignettes, evaluating accuracy, empathy, and explainability without testing an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
